allyExperience.finding: buildAlly sets exp to zero on every rebuild; kills update live exp immediately; returning to town safely writes pending gain to source save then rebuilds the ally with exp zero.
allyExperience.recommendation: Initialize ally level progress from its source role, retain _expGained as an independent settlement delta, and preserve pending gains when direct writing is blocked. Cover nonzero source progress, level-up, repeat returns, reload, concurrent source role, and failed writes before enabling.

petAndSummonBuffs.finding: Existing pets and summons already receive selected team auras; single-target shareTeamBuffs only targets the player and active allies. Healing also includes pets and summons. They have separate derived stats and attack timing paths.
petAndSummonBuffs.recommendation: Show already effective auras first, then add a small explicit buff whitelist with duration, caster MP cost, refresh rules and removal on summon expiration. Avoid duplicate aura/owner-stat bonuses and defer immunity buffs.
